manualState.thermal: 未明显发热，温度未测量

contract.accumulation: FP32; implementation may contract multiply/add into FMA

shapeEvidence.evidence: mat4x4<f16> weights; src_s reduction loop; vec4<f16> accumulators with fma; workgroup reduction
shapeEvidence.dtype: FP16 vector weights/accumulators; FP32 texture load/store conversion
shapeEvidence.layout: Packed mat4x4<f16> buffer, texture coordinates and symbolic U.i0 strides; global row-major M/N/K UNKNOWN
shapeEvidence.parameters: Eight unrolled vec4<f16> accumulators, src_s += 4, workgroup temp[32]; actual WG override constants UNKNOWN
shapeEvidence.equivalence: This FP32 dense non-fused GEMM is not an equivalent runtime replacement; no model speedup claim

input.algorithm: xorshift32, A then B, same nonzero seed independently per shape/family
input.integer: (nextU32 % 7)-3, exact products [-9,9], max absolute partial sum <=9*K <2^24

reference.method: CPU independent i-k-j traversal, Float64Array accumulator, JS binary64 arithmetic from stored FP32 A/B
reference.difference: GPU FP32 accumulation / possible FMA differ from binary64 CPU sums; no GPU-generated reference
reference.policy: Frozen before run; strict integer test; fractional absolute+relative acceptance; no relaxation after failures

timing.optionalFeature: timestamp-query explicitly requested if adapter supports it; no silent requestDevice fallback
timing.gpuBoundary: begin/end compute pass timestampWrites, one dispatch; includes possible scheduling cost, not pure arithmetic execution
timing.wallBoundary: immediately before queue.submit to onSubmittedWorkDone completion; includes query resolve/C copy, excludes map/CPU correctness
timing.protocol: Serial completion, timestamp and full C map/unmap + CPU check before next submit; waiting/readback affects caches and run state
timing.setup: Pipeline, buffers, bindings, input upload and CPU reference outside all sampling loops
timing.statistics: Measured only; median midpoint, nearest-rank p95, min/max and zeros; no trimming or speedup
timing.performanceInputFamily: fractional; both integer and fractional initial correctness required
